integrity: Same-model mathematical proof inspection and finite executable cross-check; the width-two theorem and differing Vietoris–Rips results are credited, not claimed new. Literature coverage may remain incomplete. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected unweighted base graph of girth at least five, at least one edge, and complete fiber of width at least three. No assertion for base triangles/four-cycles, noncomplete fibers, weighted edges, or Čech constructions with all geometric points as centers. Finite checks corroborate but are not infinite proofs.
title: Clique-fiber Čech nerves over graphs of girth at least five
